rules: CLAUDE.md requires typed-flow independence, meaningful behavioral tests and no claimed real infrastructure acceptance from mocks. pyproject.toml preserves six production import contracts. Test isolation forbids importing concrete inference packages.

modules.responsibility: Verify actual application startup, event delivery and shutdown using a valid graph and owned threads.
modules.interface: Tests and checker fail explicitly on invalid behavior/imports and do not change production public APIs.
allowed_dependencies: redis exception types and mocked Redis client
modules.effects: Tests own threads and timers. After joining Application.run, repeat shutdown to cancel any timer started during the first shutdown; checker only reads source files.

modules.responsibility: Verify Redis connection failure recovery through a real local emitter thread and mocked Redis client.
modules.interface: Tests and checker fail explicitly on invalid behavior/imports and do not change production public APIs.
allowed_dependencies: redis exception types and mocked Redis client
modules.effects: Tests own in-process threads and mocks and always stop them; checker only reads source files.

modules.responsibility: Enforce infrastructure-independent imports in the two scoped test modules with a prohibited-edge negative case.
modules.interface: Tests and checker fail explicitly on invalid behavior/imports and do not change production public APIs.
allowed_dependencies: redis exception types and mocked Redis client
modules.effects: Tests own in-process threads and mocks and always stop them; checker only reads source files.

contracts.rules: Scoped test modules and checker must not import concrete inference/GPU infrastructure; injected forbidden import must be rejected. Production six contracts also remain passing.

checks.command: uv run --no-sync python docs/plans/typed-flow-runtime-acceptance-20261104/check_test_boundaries.py && uv run --no-sync lint-imports --no-cache
checks.expectation: Both test modules avoid concrete inference infrastructure, injected forbidden import is rejected, six production contracts remain kept.
All safe typed-flow tests pass without unhandled thread exceptions; lifecycle events are delivered and Redis error recovery reaches subsequent flush.

checks.command: uv run --no-sync ruff check .; uv run --no-sync ruff format --check .; uv run --no-sync mypy packages/typed_flow/typed_flow; uv run --no-sync vulture
checks.expectation: Lint, formatting, typed-flow strict typing and dead-code checks return zero.

checks.command: uv run --frozen pytest -W error::pytest.PytestUnhandledThreadExceptionWarning; uv run --frozen pre-commit run --all-files
checks.expectation: The configured workspace suite and every native pre-commit hook pass without production/dependency modifications; integration/DALI exclusions remain explicit.
Timer start delayed until run-thread join must leave zero uncancelled timers after each test cleanup.

documentation: Task plan and dated verification evidence only; public runtime interfaces and README usage are unchanged by test-only repair.

review.reconciliation: Parent inspected both changed test modules, added scoped checker, plan/architecture/verification and both review artifacts. Round1 timer finding corrected and original forced interleaving independently verified. No runtime/dependency/lock/remote branch changes; no unrelated source changes present. Final record/ledger changes only record actual acceptance and local commit.
